name: OmniFarmhouse
tagline: Fresh Hydroponic Vegetables, Powered by Technology.
description: OmniFarmhouse combines modern hydroponic farming with technology, sustainability, and data-driven agriculture to produce cleaner and healthier food.
mission: Our mission is to redefine food production in Africa by using innovation, automation, and data-driven agriculture.

hydroponicBenefits.title: Uses up to 90% Less Water
hydroponicBenefits.description: Hydroponics recirculates water efficiently, reducing waste compared with traditional farming.

hydroponicBenefits.title: Cleaner Produce
hydroponicBenefits.description: Soil-free environments reduce contamination and support fresher, cleaner harvests.

hydroponicBenefits.title: Reduced Pesticide Usage
hydroponicBenefits.description: Controlled indoor systems lower pest pressure and reduce dependency on heavy pesticides.

hydroponicBenefits.title: Year-round Production
hydroponicBenefits.description: Climate-aware cultivation enables stable crop growth throughout the year.

technologyFeatures.title: NFT Hydroponic System

technologyFeatures.title: EC Monitoring

technologyFeatures.title: pH Monitoring
technologyFeatures.description: Consistent pH control supports healthier plant uptake and performance.

technologyFeatures.title: Water Recycling
technologyFeatures.description: Closed-loop systems recapture and reuse water to minimize wastage.

technologyFeatures.title: Solar Energy
